nameOrigin: the flat cutting part of a knife, sword, etc.

pokedexEntries.dp: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

pokedexEntries.pt: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

pokedexEntries.hgss: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.
